summaries.text: Amends the Federal Aviation Act of 1958 to require that civil aircraft with a maximum passenger capacity of more than 30 seats be equipped with the collision avoidance system known as TCAS-II. Sets forth a schedule for the installation of such system. Requires the Administrator of the Federal Aviation Administration to institute a program for the operational evaluation of the system. Requires the Administrator to consider the compatibility of the installation schedule of the airborne low-altitude wind shear equipment with the installation of the TCAS-II system.
